0.5.en:
Immediate situation

  • Pause announced: Trump ordered a second pause on strikes against Iran’s energy sector — 10 days, deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET. US says talks are “going very well.” Iran denies direct talks.
  • US reportedly sent Iran a written plan to end the war (New York Times).
  • Air campaign continues: US/Israeli strikes on Iran ongoing this campaign; Iran/Hezbollah/Hamas missile strikes on Israel continue overnight.
  • Northern Border: Hezbollah firing daily. Persistent exchanges; low-level escalation continues.
  • Tactical context: this is the second declared pause. The first (5 days from Mar 23) was violated hours after being declared by strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.
  • Diplomacy: Pakistan acting as mediator.
  • Hormuz / Shipping: Iran allowing passage for Russia, India, China while blocking others. Selective access raises risk to global shipping and allies’ logistics.
  • Airspace / logistics: FlightScan shows 470 aircraft tracked, 2 military. Airports closed: Iran, Iraq, Lebanon.
  • Information note: Major outlets (Reuters, Al Jazeera, Times of Israel) reporting pause; Tehran denies talks.
  • 🟢 Good News: Temporary 10-day pause and a US-written peace plan create a diplomatic window.

Bottom line:

  • Threat assessment: escalating

24.en:
Situation Report — Day 27

  • Active: Iranian/Hezbollah/Hamas missile strikes on Israel continue overnight; explosions reported in Tehran.
  • Northern Border: Hezbollah fires daily. 1 Israeli soldier killed, 4 wounded by anti‑tank missile in southern Lebanon.
  • Air campaign & strikes: Trump ordered a 10‑day pause on strikes against Iran’s energy sector until Apr 6, 20:00 ET — this is the second pause. First 5‑day pause was violated earlier in the campaign.
  • Diplomacy: Pakistan mediating. US reportedly sent Iran a written plan to end the war. Iran denies direct talks; intermediaries report indirect contacts.
  • Naval / Hormuz: Iran allows passage for select friendly states (Russia, India, China) while restricting others. Trump extended Iran’s deadline to reopen the strait by 10 days.
  • Maritime ISR/kinetic: US deployed uncrewed drone boats to the theater (Reuters). Tactical effect: increases stand‑off ISR and strike options for US naval forces.
  • Airspace / transport: Airports closed across Iran, Iraq, Syria and Lebanon in recent flight scans. Civil aviation severely reduced.
  • Diplomatic action: Iran filed a protest to the UN Security Council over Gulf states allegedly allowing US operations from their territory.
  • Wider concerns: European intelligence flags risk of Russian drone deliveries to Iran. Cyber: 1 critical incident detected (unconfirmed details).
  • Economic: Brent near $107 after volatility following the pause announcement.
  • 🟢 Good News: 10‑day pause creates a window for mediated talks; Pakistan engaged; US shared a settlement plan—space to de‑escalate if both sides engage.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating — high risk of renewed strikes if talks collapse.

Diplomacy & pauses

  • President Trump announced a SECOND pause on strikes targeting Iran's energy sector for 10 days (deadline: Apr 6, 2026, 8 PM ET).

Iranian & proxy strikes

  • Iranian missile and proxy (Hezbollah/Hamas) strikes on Israel continued overnight and in the past 48 hours.
  • Israel/US continue airstrikes inside Iran.

Northern border

  • Daily Hezbollah activity. Anti-tank and rocket strikes against Israeli positions persist.
  • Ground, artillery, and tactical missile exchanges ongoing.

Maritime & regional

  • Iran opened the Strait of Hormuz to select friendly states (Russia, India, China) while restricting others. Trump extended deadline related to Hormuz by 10 days.
  • Iran protested to the UN Security Council over Gulf states allowing US operations from their territory.

Military & cyber

  • US deployed uncrewed drone boats in the area — new maritime autonomy in use.
  • European concern that Russia may supply drones to Iran.
  • Airspace disruptions: airports closed in Iran, Iraq, Lebanon, Syria. Flight traffic sharply reduced.
  • Cyber scan reported one critical incident in last 48h.

🟢 Good News

Threat assessment

  • Escalating — high risk of renewed strikes despite the pause.
